frozenDeployedDecoder.note: The deployed decoder does not check the part count: it reads the nine-part trade and drops the expiry. Expiry is only enforced once the candidate is activated by a coordinated version/code-hash rollout.

releaseGate: Do not enable live channel funding until the candidate (expiry, column endpoint, capability route) is activated and the wallet points at a listener that reports tl_getProtocolCapabilities.
